caption:
Seven habits worth dropping this week.

The hardest one to stop was number 1. Checking emails in bed meant my head was at work before I'd even got up, and the whole day felt reactive.

Number 4 has research behind it. A 2017 University of Texas study found that simply having your phone on the desk reduced people's working memory, even when it was face-down and silent. Phones left in another room did best.

Save this for Monday morning, and send it to the colleague with 40 tabs open.
